record.question: Which country becomes the first to end FM radio broadcasting?
record.explanation: Answer D: Norway. Norway’s contemporaneous government account records the national FM shutdown beginning in Nordland on 11 January 2017 and continuing region by region. Norway is the intended country. Historical/source note: National FM networks switched off; local FM stations were not all abolished. The original’s unqualified end FM broadcasting is too broad. Reference: https://www.regjeringen.no/no/dokumenter/prop.-129-s-20162017/id2553020/?ch=2. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
